mapper.select: SELECT TO_CHAR(t1.TR_YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS tr_ymd_str , t1.TR_YMD AS tr_ymd , t1.WONBON_AEK AS wonbon_aek , t1.JM_PER AS jm_per , t1.USD_WONBON_AEK AS usd_wonbon_aek , ROUND(t1.USD_WONBON_AEK * NVL(t1.JM_PER, 0) / 100, 2) AS usd_tuja , t1.YEAR_BETA AS year_beta , t1.MON_BETA AS mon_beta , t1.RISK_VALUE AS risk_value , t1.FX_SU AS fx_su , t1.FX_AMT AS fx_amt , t1.OPT_PREMIUM AS opt_premium , t1.OPT_NOMINAL_AMT AS opt_nominal_amt , t1.DEL AS del , 0 AS p_visible , TO_CHAR(t1.TR_YMD, 'iw') AS week FROM SZT0IA_V t1 WHERE t1.CORP_GR = #{corpGr} AND t1.FUND_CD = #{fundCd} AND t1.TR_YMD BETWEEN ADD_MONTHS(#{ymd}, -12) AND #{ymd} AND t1.TR_YMD NOT IN (SELECT HOLI_YMD FROM SZX0HL ta WHERE ta.NATION_CD = 'US' AND ta.HOLI_YMD >= ADD_MONTHS(#{ymd}, -12)) AND NVL(t1.DEL, 'N') = 'N' ORDER BY t1.TR_YMD DESC
